beats.speaker: narration
beats.text: The first single's been out a week, and the internet has opinions.

beats.speaker: client
beats.text: "A blogger tore it apart this morning — called the whole thing derivative. Everyone around me is saying I should claw back publicly, prove them wrong."

options.text: Clawing back isn't the only way to prove anything.
You should absolutely go after them.
Why would you respond to a stranger's opinion at all?

beats.speaker: client
beats.text: "Part of me wants to. Part of me just feels sick about it."

beats.speaker: reader
beats.text: You turn over the top card.

options.text: Real strength here isn't clawing back — it comes from the heart, not force.
It means you should fight harder, not softer.
This card has nothing to do with how you respond.

elaboration: Real strength is gentle — it comes from the heart, not force. Taming the instinct to lash out with calm isn't weakness, it's the whole point.

beats.speaker: client
beats.text: "Doesn't staying gentle just mean I let people walk over me?"

options.text: No — courage here means acting honestly, not acting fearlessly or aggressively.
Courage isn't part of this card.

elaboration: Courage means acting honestly, not acting fearlessly — standing your ground doesn't require swinging first.

beats.speaker: client
beats.text: "...Okay. Maybe not responding at all is the stronger move here."
